eclŏgārĭus , a, um, adj. ecloga,
I.of or belonging to a selection; only as subst.
I. eclŏgārĭum , i, n., a collection of selected poems, the title of a book of Ausonius, Weber, Corp. Poet. Lat. pp. 1254 sqq.—
II. eclŏgārii , ōrum, m., sc. libri, = eclogae, select passages from a work, Cic. Att. 16, 2 fin. Orell. N. cr.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
